inferred_research_gaps.evidence: 16/20 papers are not code-ready exact reruns under local constraints.
inferred_research_gaps.gap: Exact paper-result reruns are structurally blocked for many papers without checkpoint/data/API provenance.
inferred_research_gaps.paper_move: A strict systems paper should publish a runnable benchmark harness with fallback tiny fixtures, not only full-scale scripts.

inferred_research_gaps.evidence: Max local-window RMSE vs dense was 0.121248 at context 8192.
inferred_research_gaps.gap: KV/cache locality speedups need quality guards, because local windows can diverge from full-context attention.
inferred_research_gaps.paper_move: Report speed together with semantic/correctness deltas under long-context stress.

inferred_research_gaps.evidence: Max merge RMSE vs full attention was 0.553301 with 256 kept tokens.
inferred_research_gaps.gap: Token merging methods need instance-adaptive retention, not only fixed token budgets.
inferred_research_gaps.paper_move: Tie merge ratio to failure cases and preserve a task-quality metric next to throughput.

inferred_research_gaps.evidence: Lowest effective modeled speedup was 0.0 at draft noise 0.32.
inferred_research_gaps.gap: Speculative decoding speedup is acceptance-limited, so draft quality is a first-class systems variable.
inferred_research_gaps.paper_move: Report acceptance distributions and not just raw draft/target latency.

inferred_research_gaps.evidence: Lowest retained mass was 0.029347 for top_k_128.
inferred_research_gaps.gap: Sampling/token-pruning claims need probability-mass and entropy audits.
inferred_research_gaps.paper_move: Frame hyperparameter-free decoding as a constrained mass/entropy problem, not only a recipe.

inferred_research_gaps.evidence: 48 masked sparse controls failed to beat dense matvec despite lower density.
inferred_research_gaps.gap: Unstructured sparsity is not automatically a kernel speedup.
inferred_research_gaps.paper_move: Require hardware-aware sparse layout/kernel measurements before claiming sparse efficiency.
